request.query: Hasse-Schmidt higher derivations annihilate scalars in positive degree

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_C
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ) (r : R), 0 < k → (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) (Polynomial.C r) = 0

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_apply_one
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ), 0 < k → (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) 1 = 0

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_X
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (k : ℕ), 1 < k → (Polynomial.hasseDeriv k) Polynomial.X = 0

items.name: ModuleCat.Derivation.d_map
items.type:
∀ {A B : CommRingCat} {M : ModuleCat ↑B} {f : A ⟶ B} (D : M.Derivation f) (a : ↑A),
  D.d ((CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom f) a) = 0

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_eq_zero_of_lt_natDegree
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ), p.natDegree < n → (Polynomial.hasseDeriv n) p = 0
